title: The Sapphires
tagline: Four voices. One stage. A lot of soul.
about: In 1968, four young Aboriginal women from a country mission form a soul group and tour Vietnam to sing for the troops.
cue: Serve the mains when the Sapphires hit the stage for the troops in Vietnam.
faces: EVERY NIGHT, A TABLE FOR YOU
“Girls, you sing soul and those boys over there need it. Eat first, then take the stage.”
Four voices. One stage. A lot of soul.
